purpose: Actual bounded exploratory P0/P1/finite-T/transport-admission integration, not experimental qualification, novel discovery or calibrated model validation

dynamics.legacy_P2_thresholds: Use unchanged P2_PROTOCOL_DEFAULTS; no post-outcome tuning

transport.P25: Run existing artifact-verified analysis only when the existing P2 PASS eligibility gate permits it; preserve all failures and INDETERMINATE outcomes
transport.P3: No conductivity or Arrhenius extrapolation from this 0.2 ps production pilot. A numerical self-MSD slope may be diagnostic only after P2/P25 admission; never qualify diffusion or set unsupported D=0.

baseline: Unrelaxed source geometry static energy/forces and P0-only admission versus actual relaxation plus finite-T evidence; no same-budget accuracy or discovery-superiority claim

hypotheses.numerical_integration: Source-bound P0, pinned-model P1 and finite-T calculations either execute with verifiable persisted outputs or retain explicit failures
hypotheses.relaxation: Converged relaxation lowers or preserves same-model energy within 1e-6 eV and reaches the frozen force threshold
hypotheses.replay: Same candidate/seed/dt repeats agree to absolute 1e-8 in positions and metrics; compare physical arrays, not wall time
hypotheses.selection: Digital shortlist must abstain while model calibration, converged transport, finite-size and independent-model evidence are unresolved

limits: Known historical reference structures, not novel generated candidates
Single exact MLIP with unknown training exposure
Unit cells and sub-ps trajectories cannot establish bulk transport or long-term stability
No new original TEST121 access, physical measurements or physical qualification
A zero-survivor digital portfolio is legitimate
